periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Marked downward tapering with the geometric centroid shifted towards the superior boundary.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly convex and rounded curvature at the superior margins.
